decisions.reason: Selecting Base Mainnet for the contract-event webhook is consistent with the candidate's existing Base Mainnet deployment scope and does not change its state.
Webhook configuration does not alter the requirement to remediate the wallet-login security warning.
The source configures backend event ingestion and does not direct any change to FAQ copy.
The webhook name, network, contract address, and URL do not change the About page's approved content.
The contract-event webhook procedure has no necessary effect on the landing-page hero copy or layout.
Using ProjectRebuild in the webhook's administrative name does not change the product's current or planned branding.
The backend webhook configuration does not modify any mission-page content.
Contract-event ingestion settings do not affect the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
Adding a production event webhook does not change the requirement that the production website remain reachable.
The webhook procedure does not entail any revision to landing-page mechanics copy.
Although contract events may support backend processing generally, the source does not change winner announcement or notification channels.
Configuring event ingestion for the supplied contract address does not change the established contract-migration or data-continuity policies.
